name: v5-clip
what_changes_vs_v4: the appearance embedder only: PRTreID (BPBreID/HRNet-32) -> the cluster session-3 CLIP ViT-B/16 + 256-d projection, trained on the unified GSR + SoccerNet-re-ID corpus. Every other stage (detector, tracker, calibration gate + fill, OCR chain, aggregation floor 0.80, jersey-compatibility merge gate, solver config, free team map, self roster) is byte-identical to the frozen v4 bundle.

embedder.provenance: cluster session 3, ~/runs/clip_uni/epoch8.pt on a100server1; valid-split identity mAP 58.75 / team mAP 77.45 (results/CLUSTER_SESSION3.md)
embedder.input: RGB uint8 crop -> cv2 INTER_CUBIC resize to 224x224 -> /255 -> CLIP mean/std -> L2-normalised output
embedder.selected_by: env GSR_EMBEDDER=clip, which drives eval.gsr_gta.CACHE_SUBDIR and tools.gsr_v4.config_key so no PRTreID artifact is ever reused

retuned_on_dev20.why: the CLIP embedding space has a ~4.8x wider absolute cosine-distance scale than PRTreID (DEV-20: within-track d p90 0.2311 vs 0.0395; cross-track d p10 0.4287 vs 0.0931), so an absolute merge ceiling tuned on PRTreID is far too tight
retuned_on_dev20.chosen: argmax of DEV-20 GS-HOTA inside a broad flat region (0.320-0.520 all within 0.18 GS-HOTA)

not_retuned.note: the solver's appearance term is also in cosine units and is therefore ALSO mis-scaled for this embedding (estimated equivalents: sim_none ~0.67, app_gain ~3). It was NOT retuned in this session. The v5 numbers are therefore a LOWER bound on what this embedder can do, not its tuned optimum.

verification_plan: valid TEST-38 exactly once at this frozen bundle, control re-derived in the same run; official test-49 only if TEST-38 beats v4's 36.71.
